Django News Application
  • Django News Application

Django News Application

The Django News Application is a newsroom website with three kinds of accounts. Journalists write articles, editors review and approve them, and readers browse approved stories and subscribe to the publishers and journalists they like. Approved articles are emailed to subscribers, and a token-authenticated REST API exposes the same content to other programs.

Note

This HTML documentation is pre-built and stored in the repository at docs/_build/html/. Open docs/_build/html/index.html in a web browser to read it. You do not need to install anything to view it.

Where to start

  • New to the project? Read the Project overview first.

  • Want to run it? Follow Installation, then Quickstart and usage.

  • Calling the HTTP API? See REST API endpoints.

  • Looking for a class or function? Browse the API reference.
